meetings.title: Regen Knowledge Commons Sync — V1 Pipeline Scope, Geo Browser, Linear Projects + org-os on a Branch
meetings.summary: The call where V1 got a frozen scope, a shipping date and three tracked Linear projects with named leads. V1 source is the Regen Coordination Hub alone (two-layer link crawl; 5 categories, 31 topics); the crux is an agentic API that ingests, cleans, applies the ontology, structures and proposes to Geo Browser. Geo Browser adopted as the governed data layer (IPFS + The Graph; per-space subgraph governed by an embedded Aragon DAO, Privy login) with forkable ontologies explicitly as a guard against ontological violence — the starter ontology (repurposed from an OpenCivics swarm jam) lives in the commons, individual spaces fork from it. knowledge-commons repo holds API code, schemas, ontology configs, validation logic and README docs only; data lives in R2 buckets / a database (Git is version control, not a data store; durable-object migration pain). Schemas replicated into the repo for validation, so incomplete Geo entries get rejected before surfacing. Linear = source of truth, Telegram = async, two-week cycles matched to this call. Three projects: Commons Pipeline (Monty lead), Repo Stabilization (Luiz lead, org-os + knowledge-management layer, currently sole member), Integrity Suite (created live for Durgadas, needs scoping). Integrity Suite calibrates before it hard-gates; two workflows — Ore Instruct alone for messy bulk data, full 6-layer Craft chain with Ore Instruct either side when quality must be absolute. Luiz's org-os proposal answered: branch off knowledge-commons, keep main clean, prove value before merging; Regen OS deferred to next cycle. V1 editors = core team, proposing open-ish / approving closed; Greenpill S7 criteria already push project commitments to the Hub as a ready-made source. Timeline: end-Sept API live + Geo set up, Oct run the pipeline in earnest, next cycle brings Regen OS/Coop/KC corpus. Fundraising deferred to the Regen Coordination conversation (budget retro first, then incentive design; Artizen reimbursement unsolved; Matt's lane = fundraising). External sharing = reach a threshold then go targeted, DAIAA as first audience. NOTE: the regen-toolkit main clean-slate move was never discussed.
decisions: V1 scope frozen narrow — Regen Coordination Hub as the sole source; Regen OS, Coop and the KC corpus deferred to the next cycle
Agentic API is the crux of V1; two APIs (toolkit ingestion + Durgadas's integrity harness) talking to each other
Geo Browser adopted as the governed data layer; forkable ontologies to prevent ontological violence
Starter ontology belongs in the commons space, not individual spaces; individual spaces fork from it
knowledge-commons repo holds code/schemas/configs, NOT data — data in R2 buckets / external DB
No one-to-one repo mirroring of pipeline data; complexity outweighs benefit
Linear is the source of truth; Telegram for async; two-week cycles synced to this call
Three Linear projects with leads — Commons Pipeline (Monty), Repo Stabilization (Luiz), Integrity Suite (Durgadas, created in-call)
org-os goes on a branch off knowledge-commons; main stays clean; evaluate before any merge
Integrity Suite lets everything through initially to calibrate scoring, becomes a hard gate later
V1 Geo editors = the core team; proposing relatively open, approving closed
Timeline: end-September API live + Geo set up; October run the pipeline in earnest
External sharing: reach a quality threshold, then share selectively with plugged-in people — not a broad blast
Fundraising deferred to the Regen Coordination conversation; budget retro precedes incentive design

meetings.title: Regen Toolkit Engineering Sync — Linear, Cloudflare, Sliced Repo Merge + Schema Convergence
meetings.summary: The sync where process infrastructure landed. Three adoptions in one call: Linear for project management (Afo leads — initiatives/projects/issues, two-week cycles aligned to the biweekly with the cycle starting the day after, exponential estimates, free plan = everyone admin, AI/GitHub integrations, Customers feature), Cloudflare Workers for hosting (Rather — branch previews + built-in CI/CD, needs org access, replaces the 07-16 Netlify dev-build ask), and a dedicated coordination group (Afo to create; stops the split across the top group and the Regen Coordination council group). Repo merge unblocked with four ordered slices (framework+schemas with tests → deterministic generators+validation → public-safe aggregate data + selected Astro surfaces → reviewed knowledge objects after the promotion gate), keeping internal org-os coordination material out of the production projection; Afo's amendment: stabilise dev and prod as mirrors first so contribution can start, org-os work stays on its own branch until then. Schema convergence resolved the Rather↔Regis tension: converge on integration points and pin versions with strict Zod/TypeScript schemas validated on send and receive, but write a distinct schema per object class rather than flattening (Regis's law-vs-oracle-vs-time-standard objection). Ingestion layer named the near-term gate (Matty's four-stage priority frame: functionalise the engine → improve existing knowledge → feed the engine + human review → tracks/deployment). Rather's probabilistic-interpretation problem: big standards docs yield a thousand interpretations across a thousand agents — ship a reference implementation in code instead. Afo: organise around roles/boundaries and identify Customers. Artizen: weight behind the BREAD fund this week (Luiz ~100k, Afo 50–100k), boosts fund cash prizes only and raise matching availability, project boosts near-worthless, spend late against the leaderboard; ~$164 (+10% ≈ $182) executed live from the safe plus a Solidarity Fund transaction. Post-close tail: Harmonica evolving into a deliberative runtime (CLI + MCP, deterministic over probabilistic — Rather paying for it), Bonfire as knowledge-graph memory requiring a rigid ontology loaded early or you get slot mess, local Apple Silicon inference for deterministic tasks. Identity resolved: Regis Chapman = Durgadas (listed as two people in the 07-16 note).
